shortDescription.default: Read-only Copilot oversharing readiness review: site risk signals, owner attestation, and CSV export for audit.

longDescription.default: Read-only SharePoint web part that reviews site sharing risk before Microsoft 365 Copilot rollout. Mock data is the default for demonstration and screenshots; live mode lists sites from SharePoint Search and writes owner attestations to a SharePoint list. It does not change site permissions or sharing links.
